old_caption:
The video begins with a close-up shot inside a spacecraft or space station. A person wearing a green shirt and beige pants is seen from behind, holding a small object in their right hand. The individual appears to be examining or interacting with something on the wall, which consists of white panels with various markings and equipment. The environment is filled with wires, cables, and technical apparatus, indicating a highly technical and controlled setting typical of a space station.

The person remains in the same position throughout the clip, with no camera motion or significant change in the scene. The small object is held steadily, and the individual's posture and focus do not shift. The background remains static, showing the same white panels, equipment, and cables without any movement or alteration.

caption:
Inside a microgravity module, a man with short gray hair, glasses, a green polo shirt, tan trousers and a black wristwatch floats in the left foreground, viewed from behind. He extends his right hand and balances a small metallic dome-shaped object on the tip of his index finger. The white paneled wall behind him is crossed by a thin diagonal cable and a horizontal dark cable, with two circular hatch covers at the top, a fabric bag on the right and a blue rail along the bottom.

Across the bulk of the excerpt the metallic object remains resting on the fingertip with essentially no change in position relative to the hand or the panel. The man's head, arm and body hold their orientation, and only tiny successive vertical differences hint at slow floating drift. The diagonal and horizontal cables, the hatch covers and the bag keep identical positions throughout, confirming the camera is stationary and the apparent stillness belongs to the balanced object.

Toward the close of the excerpt the object shifts and blurs. It displaces horizontally from the fingertip. A motion-blur streak trails across the panel as it starts to drift away.

replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
